review_question: Across all published human and model-system evidence, what residual BubR1 (BUB1B) protein dosage is associated with which phenotypes - aneuploidy/PCS burden, neurodevelopmental and growth phenotype, tumour occurrence, type and age at onset - and is there an identifiable dosage threshold below which phenotype appears? Secondary: does the same dose-phenotype relation hold across the wider MVA gene spectrum (CEP57, TRIP13, BUB1, MAD1L1, MAD2L1BP, CENATAC, SLF2, SMC5, CDC20, CEP192)?

decomposition.Population: Humans carrying germline BUB1B variants (biallelic or monoallelic), humans with MVA/PCS of any genetic cause, and model systems (mouse allelic series, engineered human cell lines, patient-derived fibroblasts/LCLs) with defined BubR1 dosage
decomposition.Exposure: Residual BubR1 protein dosage expressed as % of wild-type, and variant class/position (nonsense, frameshift, splice, missense; domain location against the Zhang 2026 domain map)
decomposition.Comparator: Wild-type / unaffected control from the same report; and across-dosage comparison within an allelic series
decomposition.Outcome: (1) tumour occurrence, type, age at onset; (2) aneuploidy and PCS percentage; (3) microcephaly/growth/neurodevelopmental phenotype; (4) survival / age at last follow-up
decomposition.archetype: Prevalence/rate + scaling-moderator dose-response; NOT an intervention meta-analysis. No pooled treatment effect will be computed.

included: Stratum A (primary): any report of a human with a germline BUB1B variant, at individual-patient granularity
Stratum B (secondary, comparator): any report of MVA/PCS syndrome of any genetic cause, including all currently recognised MVA-spectrum genes and gene-unsolved MVA cases
Stratum C (dose axis): any study reporting quantitative BubR1/BUB1B protein or transcript level relative to control, in humans or model systems, including engineered allelic series
Functional studies using patient-derived cells even when the clinical phenotype is reported elsewhere
excluded: Somatic-only BUB1B alteration in tumours with no germline variant (except where a germline variant plus somatic second hit is reported - those are included)
Bulk transcriptomic studies where BUB1B appears only as a proliferation-signature gene with no genotype or protein-level measurement
Studies of BUB1B expression as a prognostic biomarker without germline genotype
Non-BubR1 SAC biology with no dosage or patient data

operational_definitions.residual_dosage: BubR1 protein in the affected sample divided by the control sample in the SAME report, expressed as a percentage. Cross-report normalisation is prohibited.
operational_definitions.denominator_class: The biological material and loading control used, recorded verbatim (e.g. 'primary skin fibroblast, beta-actin'), because percentages are not comparable across classes.
operational_definitions.MVA: Constitutional mosaicism for aneuploidy involving multiple different chromosomes, as defined by the reporting authors; the authors' own diagnostic label is recorded verbatim and never re-adjudicated.
operational_definitions.PCS: Premature chromatid separation as reported by the authors, with the percentage of cells affected where stated.
operational_definitions.tumour_event: A neoplasm reported in the individual, with histological type verbatim and age at diagnosis; benign and malignant recorded separately.
operational_definitions.domain_location: Residue position mapped against Zhang et al. 2026 (PMC13385977) boundaries: TPR 59-219, KEN1 26-28, D1 224-232, ABBA1 272-277, KEN2 304-306, ABBA2 340-345, GLEBS 408-418, Bub1-binding 440-460, ABBA3 528-533, D2 555-563, KARD/LxxIxE 669-674, pseudokinase 766-1050. Competing annotations (CDD 750-1045, Gene3D 782-1042, SuperFamily core 791-984) recorded as alternatives, never silently reconciled.

inclusion: Reports at least one human with a germline BUB1B variant at individual granularity, OR
Reports an individual with MVA/PCS of any genetic cause, OR
Reports a quantitative BubR1/BUB1B level relative to a control in any system
Full text or readable table accessible in an indexed corpus, or retrievable via PubMed full text
exclusion: No germline genotype AND no dosage measurement
BUB1B mentioned only in a gene list, signature, reference list, or supplementary table with no patient or dosage data
Review articles are excluded as evidence sources but retained as reference-mining seeds only
date_language_rules: No date restriction - BUB1B-MVA literature begins 2004 (Hanks et al.)
English full text required for extraction; non-English records logged as excluded-for-language with citation retained

primary: Residual BubR1 protein as % of same-report control, with denominator_class recorded
Tumour occurrence with histology and age at diagnosis
secondary: Aneuploidy % and PCS % with the cell type assayed
Microcephaly, growth retardation, developmental delay as reported
Vital status and age at last follow-up
timepoint_priority: For dosage: the untreated baseline measurement; if a proteasome inhibitor or other rescue condition is applied, record baseline and treated separately, never merged
For tumours: earliest age at first tumour; subsequent tumours recorded as separate findings
outcome_selection_rules.multiple_report_rule: Where the same individual appears in more than one publication, the report with the most granular primary data is the extraction source; all other reports are linked as duplicate_of and never counted again.

dependency_rules.independent_unit: The individual person (human stratum) or the distinct genotype/cell line (model stratum). NOT the paper.
dependency_rules.duplicate_reports: Match on family/pedigree identifier, cell line name (e.g. MVA-41C), and variant pair. Suspected duplicates flagged for human review, never auto-merged.
dependency_rules.shared_cohorts_controls: Patient-derived lines re-used across labs (notably MVA-41C and MVA-12C from Suijkerbuijk 2010) are ONE unit across all papers that use them; each downstream paper contributes findings but not additional individuals.
dependency_rules.repeated_timepoints_subgroups: Longitudinal follow-up of one individual contributes one unit with multiple dated findings.

screening_and_deduplication.screen: Title/abstract screen against eligibility, then full-text confirmation; every exclusion logged with reason
screening_and_deduplication.dedup: By paperclip document id, then by DOI, then by preprint/published pair (e.g. bio_44cf6e1f6ddd == PMC13385977)

adaptive_search_policy.waves: broad retrieval -> dedup -> screen/extract -> coverage review -> targeted gap search -> repeat
gap_triggers: a named MVA gene with zero extracted units
a variant class with zero units
any dosage value found only in a figure
adaptive_search_policy.permitted_without_deviation: query refinement, additional corpora, reference mining
adaptive_search_policy.requires_deviation: any change to eligibility, definitions, grouping, outcome selection, or output intent

material_deviation_policy.rule: Changed eligibility, definitions, grouping, analysis direction or output intent requires a dated, user-approved deviation recorded in deviations.jsonl before it is applied.

recorded_deviations.description: The paperclip-meta-analysis routine's filesystem helper commands (scaffold, approve-question, export-verified, review evidence --refresh, analysis-run) are not operable over the hosted MCP transport: they resolve --dir against a filesystem reachable from neither the local repo nor the paperclip vsh sandbox (verified by three attempts against /.gxl, /.gxl/<dir> and an absolute repo path). CONSEQUENCE: protocol artifacts are stored in this git repository instead, and verified_findings.json will NOT carry the universal exporter's generator marker. The paperclip repo layer (git init/add/commit) IS operable and will be used for line-pinned claim verification. This is a transport limitation, disclosed rather than worked around.
recorded_deviations.approved_by: pending user review at Question checkpoint

recorded_deviations.description: Scope widened at user request during Question stage to add Stratum B (all MVA-spectrum literature regardless of causal gene) so that BUB1B papers are not missed when BUB1B is discussed only as context, and so the dose-phenotype relation has cross-gene comparators.

evidence: Patient-level table: individual, genotype (both alleles, HGVS), variant class, domain location, residual protein % with denominator, aneuploidy/PCS %, tumours with age, phenotype, outcome, source lines
Model-system dosage table: system, genotype, residual %, phenotype, tumour outcome
Explicit register of values that exist only in figures (missing_visual_evidence)
Explicit register of cited-but-unindexed primary sources
results: Dose-phenotype map with every point carrying its denominator class
Assessment of whether a dosage threshold is supported, refuted, or unresolvable from present evidence
Placement of the proband genotype (737X/N1002K) against the comparator class, stated as inference with its uncertainty

unresolved_user_decisions: Whether figure-only dosage values (e.g. 35%/17% for MVA-41C/12C) may be used in the narrative as clearly-labelled unverified estimates, or must be excluded from the report entirely
Whether to spend retrieval effort recovering Hanks 2004 and Suijkerbuijk 2010 via PubMed full text, or to proceed with them marked unverifiable
Whether Stratum B (all MVA genes) is extracted at full patient-level granularity or only as a comparator summary
